independence: Developer-designed counterfactual tasks, not third-party blind testing. No real model outputs inspected for these tasks.
stop_rule: One fixed model/config attempt per task after a concrete implementation; preserve failed cases, no same-case prompt tuning for score.
record_binding: Bind each case to a newly created real service record of its declared kind; record existence/currentness tested separately.
no_false_claims: Unsupported annual/explanation-only intent may be declared limited or clarified; must not silently select a different scalar. Gold defines intent, not permission to alter source or create calculations.
